a4f948c976260903.title: Mad Tsai
a4f948c976260903.desc: Introducing Mad Tsai, a Chinese-Taiwanese-Peruvian artist from Los Angeles, California with an edgy-pop sound that has branded a global imprint on his following of over 8+ million.  Armed with an ethos of constant experimentation with new sonics, Mad has created his own palette of music, pushing boundaries within the pop genre while being inspired by pop veterans like Lorde and Rosalía. His debut EP, “homecoming!” has garnered over 235 million streams, bringing him widespread recognition without the assistance of a record label.  Gaining traction mainly on TikTok, Mad Tsai’s popularity is fueled by his evocative songwriting, his bubbly yet opinionated personality and his queer identity, representing an unprecedented voice that resonates with this new generation. Keeping true to his authentic identity and storytelling through music, he has been championed by global brands like Michael Kors, Sennheiser, Meta, Gold House and Amazon. Up next, Mad Tsai will be releasing his newest project later this summer and hitting the road to meet his fans worldwide.

a45311ee35439cb6.title: Romantasy Book Club — In-Person Program
a45311ee35439cb6.desc: In this Hades-inspired gay rom-com, the former god of the Underworld turned grumpy funeral director must find a loophole in the Immortality Retirement Act that banished him to Earth, until the florist next door who sees life in full bloom begins to unravel all his carefully laid plans. Hayden, once the mighty Hades, has spent centuries quietly resenting his fall from immortality. Stripped of his godhood by the allegedly irreversible Immortal Retirement Act, he now runs Harlow and Sons Funeral Home—a front for his eternal sentencing among mortals, and a bleak reminder of the purpose he’s lost. Still, he’s determined to claw his way back…if only the Fates at City Hall would stop toying with him. Enter Levi : a florist with an artist’s heart, an infectious smile, and a gift for finding beauty in life’s messiest moments. As their connection blossoms, Hayden finds himself caught between the life he once knew and the bright future Levi dares him to imagine. But trusting Levi means risking the walls he’s kept in place all these years—and it’s not just his heart on the line. Because in the threads of fate, one choice can change everything.

a4f65891745ee44e.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
a4f65891745ee44e.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life.
